literal_meaning: ঘাম ঝরানো (sweat to shed or pour)
figurative_meaning_en: To undergo or perform excessive hard labor
similar_in_english: Earn one's bread by the sweat of one's brow
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি ঘাম ঝরিয়ে তার পরিবারের জন্য রুটি উপার্জন করেন।
এই কাজটি করতে অনেক ঘাম ঝরাতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He earns his family's bread by shedding sweat through hard work.
This job will require shedding a lot of sweat.
note: The idiom reflects the value of manual labor in Bengali agrarian society.
